title: rstats
summary: A cross-platform Rust terminal dashboard for live system resources, processes, alerts and history.
challenge: Sample CPU, memory, swap, load, network and disk on macOS, Linux and Windows, and keep enough bounded history that a spike is still visible after it has passed.
decisions: One native binary per platform, shipped through the npm package's optional dependency
Bounded per-metric history drawn as sparklines instead of a scrolling log
Alerts are sustained: threshold, duration, severity, cooldown and a recovery threshold
Recordings are portable JSONL, so an interrupted session stays loadable
ownership: Designed and built the dashboard and its recording layer end to end.
